'''Shielded''' is an [[Engineering Blueprints|Engineering Blueprint]] for [[Frame Shift Drive|Frame Shift Drives]]. It increases module integrity, reduces thermal load, and provides a modest optimized-mass increase, at the cost of increasing the drive's own mass.<ref name="inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/3/ Frame Shift Drive – Shielded], INARA.</ref>

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|infobox|fsd_shielded}}

== Effects and trade-offs ==

The Blueprint scales through Grades 1–5. Higher grades progressively:

* increase FSD integrity;
* reduce thermal load;
* increase optimized mass by a smaller amount than [[Increased Range]]; and
* increase the module's mass.

At Grade 5, the listed modifiers are +125% integrity, −30% thermal load, +15% optimized mass, and +20% module mass. The added module mass partially offsets the range benefit from optimized mass.

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|gradeTable|fsd_shielded}}

== Selection considerations ==

Shielded is a durability-oriented choice for ships whose FSD may be exposed to module damage or whose heat budget is constrained. Its large integrity increase allows the module to absorb more damage before reaching the same percentage of health, while its thermal modifier lowers heat generated by FSD operation.

For ships built primarily around maximum jump range, [[Increased Range]] provides a much larger optimized-mass bonus. [[Faster Boot Sequence]] instead prioritises startup time. Shielded is appropriate when survivability and lower heat are worth more than the range those alternatives provide.

A compatible [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] can adjust range, mass, heat, fuel use, or integrity, but only one Experimental Effect may be installed on the drive.

== Availability ==

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|engineers|fsd_shielded}}

Blueprint grades can be applied through [[Remote Engineering]] after the Blueprint is pinned and the required Engineer access has been earned. Experimental Effects still require a visit to an Engineer workshop.
